lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Are you there?
Where are you?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Me? Good question. Where am I?
So you are not coming.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Uh huh. No.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Why would I go and meet someone that's about to die?
Will I die?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: You know what?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Although it's hearsay,

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: there are many outlaws hidden in the abandoned hospital.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: It's where the pests are hiding.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Doesn't that give your goosebumps?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: So, for the good of the citizens, we decided to blow up the entire neighborhood.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Was it in 10 minutes or 20 minutes? I can't remember.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: By then, everything will explode.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Try your best in escaping, te-hee.
Can I ask you one last question?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Ah, you want to know what kind of person you were?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: But does that matter now? You are dead anyway, ha ha.
Do you remember the names of the people we rigged up?
Not the names we gave them, but their real names.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Suddenly sentimental? Bah.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Why would I remember those?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: I just collected money and sold them.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Yeah, you used to be like that.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Say something about the new value of mankind. Baaah.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Nothing but a hypocrite. Baaaaah.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Ah, I heard there might be Collectors around.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: Take good care of your parts ok? You know it's all Ark money, right?

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: But, lol.

lines.speaker: blackbox
lines.text: They'll be blown up anyway.
